title: 第十八课 · 路上辛苦了
subtitle: Lesson 18 — 路上辛苦了 · You must be tired from the journey

items.en: to invite; to treat (sb. to a meal)
You must be tired from the journey!
What time does the plane arrive?
I'll pick you up at the airport.

items.zh: 坐了十几个小时的飞机。
items.py: Zuò le shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí de fēijī.
items.en: I was on the plane for over ten hours.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ shì Dàwèi ba?
items.en: Liu Jing: Hello! You must be David?

items.py: Dàwèi: Shì de. Nǐ shì Liú Jīng ma?
items.en: David: Yes. Are you Liu Jing?

items.zh: 刘京：对，我是刘京。欢迎你来中国！路上辛苦了！
items.py: Liú Jīng: Duì, wǒ shì Liú Jīng. Huānyíng nǐ lái Zhōngguó! Lù shang xīnkǔ le!
items.en: Liu Jing: Yes, I'm Liu Jing. Welcome to China! You must be tired!

items.zh: 大卫：不辛苦。谢谢你来接我。
items.py: Dàwèi: Bù xīnkǔ. Xièxie nǐ lái jiē wǒ.
items.en: David: Not at all. Thanks for picking me up.

items.zh: 刘京：不客气。你的行李都拿了吗？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Bú kèqi. Nǐ de xíngli dōu ná le ma?
items.en: Liu Jing: You're welcome. Have you got all your luggage?

items.zh: 大卫：拿了。就这两个箱子。
items.py: Dàwèi: Ná le. Jiù zhè liǎng ge xiāngzi.
items.en: David: Yes. Just these two suitcases.

items.zh: 刘京：我来帮你拿吧。车在外面。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Wǒ lái bāng nǐ ná ba. Chē zài wàimiàn.
items.en: Liu Jing: Let me help you carry them. The car is outside.

items.zh: 大卫：太谢谢了！给你添麻烦了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Tài xièxie le! Gěi nǐ tiān máfan le.
items.en: David: Thank you so much! Sorry for the trouble.

data.topic: 会话2 · Dialogue 2 (Arriving at the Hotel)

items.zh: 刘京：这是你的房间。你坐了十几个小时的飞机，一定很累了。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Zhè shì nǐ de fángjiān. Nǐ zuò le shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí de fēijī, yīdìng hěn lèi le.
items.en: Liu Jing: This is your room. You flew for over 10 hours, you must be very tired.

items.zh: 大卫：还好。这个房间很好。
items.py: Dàwèi: Hái hǎo. Zhège fángjiān hěn hǎo.
items.en: David: I'm OK. This room is very nice.

items.zh: 刘京：你先休息一下吧。晚上我请你吃饭。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ xiān xiūxi yīxià ba. Wǎnshang wǒ qǐng nǐ chī fàn.
items.en: Liu Jing: Rest a bit first. I'll treat you to dinner this evening.

items.py: Dàwèi: Tài hǎo le! Xièxie nǐ.

items.zh: 刘京：有什么事，你给我打电话。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Yǒu shénme shì, nǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
items.en: Liu Jing: If you need anything, give me a call.

items.zh: 刘京：那你休息吧，我先走了。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nà nǐ xiūxi ba, wǒ xiān zǒu le.
items.en: Liu Jing: Well, get some rest. I'll go now.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (十几 / 几十 Approximate Numbers)

items.en: I'll pick you up at the airport.

items.py: Wǒ qù huǒchē zhàn jiē nǐ.
items.en: I'll pick you up at the train station.
It's fine, no trouble at all.

items.py: Nǐ de fēijī shì jǐ diǎn de?
Qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ ná yīxià xíngli.
items.en: Please help me with my luggage.

items.zh: 你的护照和签证带了吗？
items.py: Nǐ de hùzhào hé qiānzhèng dài le ma?
items.en: Have you brought your passport and visa?
